title: Carlos Alcaraz to miss Wimbledon in recovery from wrist injury
content:
Carlos Alcaraz, the two-time Wimbledon champion, will miss this year’s tournament as he continues his recovery from a right-wrist injury.

Alcaraz will also miss Queen’s, the prestigious warm-up event also held in London, after ruling himself out of the entire grass-court swing.

“My recovery is going well and I feel much better, but unfortunately I’m still not ready to be able to play, and that’s why I have to withdraw from the grass-court swing at Queen’s and Wimbledon,” Alcaraz, 22, wrote in a statement on social media.

“They are two really special tournaments for me and I’ll miss them a lot. We keep working to return as soon as possible!”

This is a developing story and will be updated.
